text:
maria: Hey team — kicking off a lightweight partner quickstart for the CloudMarket overlay module. goal: single terraform module partners can drop into their repo to wire webrtc+redwood private svc into their marketplace listing. short and actionable.
aj: love it. scope idea: VPC peering + IAM minimal role + deployment sample (helm) + smoke tests. keep it <20 files.
maria: exactly. want a single module with sane defaults, plus a ./examples/basic folder.
devon: can we use terraform 1.5 constraints and provider pinning? partners hit older versions a lot. recommend using a shim that works on 1.4/1.5.
sylvie: we should include a sample k8s helm values.yaml showing the redwood agent sidecar config and kv-cache settings. also a checklist for security review (KMS, audit logs).
maria: proposed structure in one message:
- modules/marketplace-overlay/main.tf
- modules/marketplace-overlay/variables.tf
- examples/basic/main.tf
- examples/basic/values.yaml
- docs/partner-readme.md
- tests/smoke.sh
aj: sounds good. devon, can you draft main.tf skeleton? quick pseudocode is fine.
devon: sure. snippet:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.4"
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.0" }
  }
}
module "redwood_overlay" {
  source = "./modules/marketplace-overlay"
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  partner_id = var.partner_id
}
```

devon: module should expose outputs: peering_connection_id, role_arn, redwood_endpoint
sylvie: for values.yaml, include example KV cache TTL and batching configs so partners see perf defaults.
maria: ops-bot, can you create a repo template and CI job skeleton for smoke tests? @ops-bot
ops-bot: Created ticket #PM-532 on partner-templates board. CI skeleton: GitHub Actions -> terraform fmt/validate -> terratest (optional) -> smoke.sh.
aj: smoke.sh should curl the onboarding endpoint and assert 200 and small latency (<300ms) when run from same region.
maria: timeline? i'd like a first draft by EOD Fri. sylvie and aj can review, devon to iterate on provider edge cases.
sylvie: I'll add the security checklist: KMS key policy, least-priv role template, required audit log sinks, and guidance for consent for telemetry.
devon: will add provider alias pattern for multi-account partners and example for assume_role.
aj: ping me if you need a partner contacts example for marketplace listing metadata.
maria: ok action items:
- devon: module skeleton + outputs (due Thu)
- sylvie: values.yaml + security checklist (due Thu)
- aj: CI smoke spec + example metadata (due Thu)
- maria: partner README and small announcement blurb (due Fri)

maria: thanks all. short sync tomorrow 10:30 if needed. :thumbsup:
